Discussion thread

/courses/:courseId/discussions/:discussionId
Roles: student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S11

Support contextual academic discussion with visible authorship, audience and moderation. Replies are public to the stated course/group audience rather than direct messages.

PostsOrdered articles with author/role/time, parent reference and edited/hidden state; Readable reply nesting; staff endorsed answer only if policy supports it
ComposerPosting identity and exact audience above draft; Save-state label, attachment restrictions and Post; course moderation guidance

Permissions
  • Authors may edit only own posts under published policy.
  • TA moderation requires explicit scope; no private inbox or unrestricted learner data.
  • Grades, if discussion graded, appear only through released learner results.
Responsive
  • Deep replies flatten with parent references after limited nesting.
  • Composer and audience remain visible when keyboard opens; posts wrap.
Accessibility
  • Every post is an article named by author/role; Reply identifies parent.
  • Draft and posting outcomes announce politely; focus returns to new post after success.
Data
  • Published prompt, audience/membership, posts and moderation states.
  • Own draft, parent reference and acknowledged post operation; released-grade link only.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Closing replies while composer is open blocks posting without claiming success.
  • A retry after timeout checks for the existing post before creating another.
  • Group membership loss cannot leave an active composer targeting a now-hidden audience.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
